chapters.screen: k-Nearest Neighbours. k-nearest neighbours never fits a formula. It stores every district and, when asked about a new one, averages the prices of the k most similar. The only real choice is k: watch what too few and too many neighbours do.
chapters.spoken: k-Nearest Neighbours. k-nearest neighbours never fits a formula. It stores every district and, when asked about a new one, averages the prices of the k most similar. The only real choice is k: watch what too few and too many neighbours do.

chapters.screen: Each dot is one California district: median income (x) and median house value (y). Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.
chapters.spoken: Each dot is one California district: median income and median house value. Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.

chapters.screen: Training is just storing all 12,384 districts. With k = 1 each prediction copies the single closest district, noise and all.
chapters.spoken: Training is just storing all 12,384 districts. With k equals 1 each prediction copies the single closest district, noise and all.

chapters.screen: Each frame refits with a larger k (no gradients, no weights). The right panel shows the neighbourhood around a $35k income growing.
chapters.spoken: Each frame refits with a larger k (no gradients, no weights). The right panel shows the neighbourhood around a 35 thousand dollars income growing.

chapters.screen: Validation chose k = 128: train RMSE $82k, validation $83k. Small k chases noise; huge k flattens towards the average.
chapters.spoken: Validation chose k equals 128: train root mean squared error 82 thousand dollars, validation 83 thousand dollars. Small k chases noise; huge k flattens towards the average.

chapters.screen: The unseen district finds its 128 nearest neighbours by income (teal); its prediction is simply their average price.
chapters.spoken: The unseen district finds its 128 nearest neighbours by income (teal); its prediction is simply their average price.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue = worth more than predicted.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue means worth more than predicted.

chapters.screen: kNN prices each point by averaging its k nearest training districts, so the sheet is made of flat patches, one for each set of neighbours. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.
chapters.spoken: k-nearest neighbours prices each point by averaging its k nearest training districts, so the sheet is made of flat patches, one for each set of neighbours. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.

chapters.screen: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from $83k to $65k.
chapters.spoken: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from 83 thousand dollars to 65 thousand dollars.

chapters.screen: kNN predicts by analogy: similar inputs should have similar outputs, and k sets how many to trust. Limitation: every prediction searches the stored data, so it gets slow and memory-hungry, and with many features 'nearest' stops meaning much.
chapters.spoken: k-nearest neighbours predicts by analogy: similar inputs should have similar outputs, and k sets how many to trust. Limitation: every prediction searches the stored data, so it gets slow and memory-hungry, and with many features 'nearest' stops meaning much.
